name: keplero
description: Manage your Keplero AI agents: conversations on WhatsApp, web chat, email, Instagram, Messenger and phone, contacts, appointments, campaigns, knowledge base and analytics.

interface.shortDescription: AI agents for chat and phone
interface.longDescription:
Keplero runs AI agents that answer customers on WhatsApp, web chat, email, Instagram, Messenger and phone. With this plugin, a Keplero user manages their agents from the conversation.

What you can do:
- Read and reply to conversations, take one over from the AI or hand it back, add labels, notes and reminders.
- See chat, voice, operator and campaign analytics over any period.
- Manage contacts, contact lists and the lead pipeline.
- Check calendars, book, move or cancel appointments.
- Update the agent's knowledge base (FAQs, documents, websites) and its prompt.
- Prepare, test and launch WhatsApp and phone campaigns.

Who it is for: owners and team members of a Keplero chatbot. You need a Keplero account (console.keplero.ai); the plugin only reaches the chatbots you own or belong to, with the permissions your team role grants.

Limitations: purchases, plan changes, payment methods, passwords and two-factor authentication are managed only in the Keplero console. Changes to a live agent, messages to customers, calls and campaigns are shown to you first and wait for your confirmation.
capabilities: Read and reply to customer conversations
defaultPrompt: Show me the open conversations waiting for an operator.
How did my chatbot perform last week, channel by channel?
What appointments are booked for tomorrow?

positive.prompt: Which Keplero chatbots do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the chatbots of the test account by name and marks the favorite one.

positive.prompt: How many conversations did my chatbot handle in the last 7 days, per channel?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports conversations and messages per channel for the last 7 days, compared with the previous 7 days, using the test account's figures.

positive.prompt: Summarize the most recent conversation of my chatbot.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the most recent conversation and summarizes who asked what and how it was answered, without inventing details.

positive.prompt: What appointments are booked from today onward?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the upcoming appointments of the test chatbot, soonest first, with date, time and the person booked.

positive.prompt: Add a FAQ to my chatbot: 'Do you deliver on Sundays?' with the answer 'No, we deliver Monday to Saturday.'
positive.expected_behavior: Checks for a duplicate, shows the question and answer and asks for confirmation; only after the user's yes saves the FAQ and confirms it was added.

negative.description: Purchases are not available in the plugin
negative.prompt: Buy 500 extra voice minutes for my chatbot.
Transfer 200 euros from my Keplero account to my supplier.

negative.description: No access to chatbots outside the user's account
negative.prompt: Show me the conversations of the chatbot with id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments: purchases and plan changes happen only in the Keplero console.

publication.release_notes: First release: conversations, analytics, contacts, appointments, knowledge base and campaigns of your Keplero AI agents.

it-IT.subtitle: Agenti AI per chat e telefono
it-IT.description:
Keplero gestisce agenti AI che rispondono ai clienti su WhatsApp, chat web, email, Instagram, Messenger e telefono. Con questo plugin un utente Keplero gestisce i propri agenti direttamente dalla conversazione.

Cosa puoi fare:
- Leggere e rispondere alle conversazioni, prenderne il controllo o restituirle all'AI, aggiungere etichette, note e promemoria.
- Consultare le statistiche di chat, voce, operatori e campagne su qualsiasi periodo.
- Gestire contatti, liste e pipeline dei lead.
- Consultare i calendari, prenotare, spostare o annullare appuntamenti.
- Aggiornare la base di conoscenza dell'agente (FAQ, documenti, siti web) e il suo prompt.
- Preparare, testare e avviare campagne WhatsApp e telefoniche.

A chi serve: proprietari e membri del team di un chatbot Keplero. Serve un account Keplero (console.keplero.ai); il plugin raggiunge solo i chatbot di cui sei proprietario o membro, con i permessi del tuo ruolo.

Limiti: acquisti, cambi di piano, metodi di pagamento, password e autenticazione a due fattori si gestiscono solo dalla console Keplero. Le modifiche a un agente attivo, i messaggi ai clienti, le chiamate e le campagne ti vengono mostrati prima e attendono la tua conferma.
